objects.name: Analytic 2209
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host writing setpoint values to Open Platform Communications (OPC) Data Access (DA)/Unified Architecture (UA) tags or historian writable tags without being the recognized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or Distributed Control System (DCS) control application, with values falling outside the normal operating range. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
